ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips and sparse focal scars, representing a high ratio of dark-to-light pixels (approx. 90:10).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark grey-black mapping across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are restricted to the distal tips (left and right) and a specific circular annulus near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle (~125 degrees) and shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the central trailing edges; topography becomes irregular and jagged at the distal tips due to high-contrast surface protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping upwards toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters at both distal tips; one distinct circular white ring (approx. 15-20 pixels in diameter) located left-of-center near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, unaligned light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the lower-left lobe and the far-right lobe segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scar (annulus) near the median notch; significant white calcified clusters at the distal fluke tips.
